tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京晴，气温约 6~17°C，清晨偏凉、体感约 5°C；无雨、风力不大，但空气质量很差（US AQI≈203 / PM2.5≈158），敏感人群减少户外久留、出门建议戴口罩。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周二冬中午跑步——无雨、风力不大、气温适宜，跑步窗口本身可用；主要冲突是空气质量很差，若对雾霾敏感请改室内跑/减量，或缩短暴露并戴口罩。周四可选跑：预报有雾、阵风明显偏强（模型日最大风约 17 km/h、阵风更高），户外跑请改室内或改日。周五早上健身：约 4~11°C、阵风偏强，去健身房途中注意防风保暖；若周五再选户外跑同样建议避开强风。
📅 未来7天（北京，Open-Meteo；阴晴参考模型 weather_code，空气 Open-Meteo AQ）：
• 11/3 周二 6~17°C 晴到少云（冬中午跑步日，无雨；空气很差）
• 11/4 周三 5~12°C 阴，略凉
• 11/5 周四 5~17°C 雾，阵风偏强（可选跑慎户外）
• 11/6 周五 4~11°C 主要晴偏凉，阵风偏强（晨练防风保暖）
• 11/7 周六 2~7°C 毛毛雨可能（降水约 0.3mm）
• 11/8 周日 3~12°C 毛毛雨可能（降水约 0.9mm）

（气温/降水/风：Open-Meteo 约 08:30 北京时间；空气：Open-Meteo Air Quality）
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: clear, ~6–17°C, chilly morning (feels ~5°C); dry with light wind, but very poor air (US AQI≈203 / PM2.5≈158)—limit outdoor exposure if sensitive.
🏃 Training: Tue winter noon run — dry, light wind, mild temps so the run window itself is usable; main conflict is very poor air—prefer indoor / shorter outing if haze-sensitive. Thu optional run: fog + stronger gusts — prefer indoor or another day. Fri morning gym: cooler (~4–11°C) with stronger gusts — dress windproof; skip outdoor run if windy.
📅 Next 7 days (Beijing, Open-Meteo):

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日，GPT/Codex 产品节奏与 Claude/智能体应用同台：@thsottiaux 透露 dots 将扩到 GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Terra（多模型按任务选型），并点赞 OpenAIDevs 的 Pando Git 后端（单日近 PB 级 Git 数据、推送延迟约降 80%）；OpenAI 官宣 LifeVal——按 ChatGPT 用户反馈塑造的日常个人助理基准。Anthropic 开放 Residency 申请（截止 11/22）。Karpathy 的 HackerTube（Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code 约两小时）仍是周末 Claude 落地样本。缺口：@claudeai / Andrew Ng / Google DeepMind / GeminiApp / Meta 关注列表近 48h 无高信号原创帖；无 DeepSeek 一手动态。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h, GPT/Codex product cadence and Claude/agent-in-the-wild led: @thsottiaux said dots will expand to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra (multi-model per task) and cheered OpenAIDevs’ Pando Git backend (~PB/day Git traffic, ~80% lower push latency); OpenAI launched LifeVal, an everyday personal-assistant benchmark shaped by ChatGPT user feedback. Anthropic opened Residency applications (deadline Nov 22). Karpathy’s HackerTube (~2h with Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code) remained the weekend Claude sample. Gaps: @claudeai / Andrew Ng / Google DeepMind / GeminiApp / Meta quiet on high-signal originals in ~48h; no DeepSeek primary posts in this watchlist.

summary.zh: ChatGPT/Codex 产品侧：dots 将扩展所用前沿模型家族，包括 GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Terra（更快、个性升级），并按任务自动选型多模型。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT product: expanding frontier models powering dots—including GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra (speed + personality)—with per-task multi-model routing.

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布 LifeVal：由数千 ChatGPT 用户反馈塑造的日常个人助理基准（从找托育到日常事务），强调 AGI 应帮到「真正重要的日常任务」。
summary.en: OpenAI launched LifeVal, a personal-assistant benchmark shaped by thousands of ChatGPT users’ feedback on everyday tasks that matter most.

caption.zh: OpenAI LifeVal 帖视频封面（来源：@OpenAI）

summary.zh: 点赞 OpenAI Developers 公开的 Pando：为 monorepo 自研 Git 后端，推送延迟约降 80%，日服务近 PB 级 Git 数据，以跟上智能体用量增长。
summary.en: Cheering OpenAI Developers’ Pando: a new Git backend for their monorepo—~80% lower push latency, nearly a petabyte of Git data/day—to scale with agent usage.

caption.zh: OpenAIDevs Pando 视频封面（经由 @thsottiaux 引用）

summary.zh: Anthropic Residency 开放申请：面向学者、技术创始人与资深工程师的有薪短期研究项目，不要求 ML 背景；申请截止 11/22。
summary.en: Anthropic Residency applications are open—a paid fixed-term research program for academics, technical founders, and staff engineers; no ML background required; apply by Nov 22.

summary.zh: Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code 约两小时做出 HackerTube：从 20 年 HN 约 4300 万条评论筛出 6454 个反复被推荐的视频。
summary.en: Karpathy’s weekend hack: ~2 hours with Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code built HackerTube—filtering ~43M HN comments over 20 years down to 6,454 repeatedly recommended videos.

title.zh: 更新 Model Spec：围绕五项核心价值重组行为规范
title.en: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI

summary.zh: 10/29：公开 Model Spec 按「忠实人类意图、减害、诚实透明、人类主体性、关怀」五项价值重组；补充情境/监督/主体性指引，并退役大量风格细则。
summary.en: Oct 29: public Model Spec reorganized around five values—faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty/transparency, human agency, and care—with clearer context/oversight/agency guidance and most style rules retired.

title.zh: Anthropic Residency：向资深技术领袖开放申请
title.en: Anthropic Residency: applications open for established technical leaders

summary.zh: 11/2 前后：有薪固定期限研究项目，面向学者/技术创始人/资深工程师，不要求 ML 背景；本轮截止 2026-11-22（美/英通道）。
summary.en: ~Nov 2: paid fixed-term research residency for academics/founders/staff engineers; no ML background required; this round closes Nov 22, 2026 (US/UK postings).

title.zh: JiTTesting：人在回路的全规模「落地前抓虫」
title.en: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach

summary.zh: 10/29：用 LLM 对 diff 生成即时测试（JiTTests），弱命中经规则+多模型 Judge 过滤后再人工复核；上半年在 diff 阶段抓到 74 个严重隐私缺陷。
summary.en: Oct 29: LLM just-in-time tests on diffs; rule + multi-model Judge filters weak catches before light human review—74 serious privacy bugs caught pre-land in 1H26.

alphaxivTop3.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights
alphaxivTop3.authors: Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, Omar Khattab (MIT CSAIL)

summary.zh: alphaXiv Hot #1（11/2）：报告称前沿 LLM 可直接「读/写」网络权重——诊断行为并无梯度编辑；作者报告用 GPT-6 Astra 编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 约 0.016% 权重后 MATH-500 从 7.9%→48.1%（作者自报，待独立复核）。
summary.en: alphaXiv Hot #1 (Nov 2): frontier LLMs reportedly inspect and edit raw weights without gradient descent; authors report GPT-6 Astra editing ~0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B lifted MATH-500 7.9%→48.1% (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
alphaxivTop3.authors: Gaoyue Zhou, Yvonne Wu, Zichen Jeff Cui, et al. (NYU / Meta-FAIR / AMI)

summary.zh: （Agent/具身优先）ID-WM：高层扩散采样可达子目标、低层逆动力学落地动作，长程导航/操作相对单层 world-model MPC 报告大幅提升。
summary.en: (Agent/embodied pick) ID-WM: high-level diffusion samples reachable subgoals; low-level inverse-dynamics grounds actions—large reported gains vs flat world-model MPC on long-horizon nav/manipulation.

alphaxivTop3.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
alphaxivTop3.authors: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun (Brown / NYU / AMI)

summary.zh: alphaXiv 持续热议：多描述同场景训练可让独立学到的表征对齐，相对 next-token 预测更省数据（JEPA 路径）。
summary.en: Still hot on alphaXiv: training on multiple descriptions of the same scene can align independently learned representations—more data-efficient than next-token prediction (JEPA).
